<thought>We need to provide all possible precursors when applying the nitro‑reduction template (ID 6904) to the target molecule. The target is the sulfonamide containing an aromatic primary amine. In retrosynthesis the amine is replaced by a nitro group, giving a single precursor (the nitro‑sulfonamide). The required format is a list of lists, each inner list containing the SMILES strings of the precursors. Since there is only one precursor, the inner list has one SMILES.</thought>
<final_answer>[["CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)Nc1ccccc1F"]]</final_answer>
